scope: Original Theorem 1.1 only: every real lambda>2, infinite compact alphabet, prescribed inflation rule and every associated subshift word giving a Delone set. Entire compactification/extension and Theorem 3.5 primitivity/recognizability/escape-letter quasicompactness core, full Lemma 4.1 coefficient construction, Lemma 4.2 uniform continuity, Proposition 4.3 eigenfunction/spectral identification and final closure retained. Ordinary named prerequisites: Ma\~nibo--Rust--Walton compact-alphabet results [21] Lemma 4.23, Theorem 6.8(1), Theorem 6.7(3,4,5), Theorem 5.4(B), and Schaefer [24] Theorem V.5.2/Proposition V.5.6; elementary compactness and geometric-series estimates. Strict ergodicity, transcendental example and every parameter choice are uncounted. The source introductory reciprocal description literally decreases from infinity to zero on (0,1), and its quasicompactness closing calls Proposition 2.5 a Lemma; both literal forms remain with the exact equations/core, without repair.
difficulty_reason: The task constructs and compactifies an infinite substitution alphabet while preserving continuity, then proves a uniform escape-letter growth estimate making its normalized operator quasicompact. Even after the precise named positive-operator and compact-alphabet background is allowed, the bounded power-series representation and explicit uniformly continuous positive eigenfunction must still realize every prescribed inflation factor. These nonroutine constructions exceed ordinary qualifying-exam symbolic dynamics or functional analysis; conservative H1 is used rather than relying on research-venue prestige.
